extracted.name: Elderflower collins
extracted.description: Try mixing this tall elderflower cocktail for a summer's evening. Garnish with pretty elderflower blossom and lemon if you're entertaining
instruction_lines: Put lots of ice in a collins glass or another tall glass, then add the gin, elderflower cordial and lemon juice. Add the soda water, stir gently, then garnish with a lemon slice and a sprig of fresh elderflower, if you like.
